data.name: Frank
data.message: Heading to oxygen to clean the filter, then medbay.

I found Charlie's body in medbay. I came in from cafeteria and Bob was already there with the body. My route was security, then weapons, then cafeteria, then medbay. I saw Bob earlier in security around ticks 3-4, but he must have moved through the ship to end up in medbay right when I arrived. Worth hearing where Bob came from and if anyone can vouch for Charlie's last location.

I need to correct Diana's account. My route was weapons, then security, then electrical — I was NOT in medbay when she found the body. I think she's confusing me with someone else, or misrepresenting things.

I was actually with Diana in security at ticks 2-3, so I can confirm she was there. She left security toward weapons at tick 4. After that, I went to electrical where I saw Alice at ticks 8-9. Alice came into electrical from medbay at tick 8 — which is very interesting given that's where Charlie's body was found.

So Alice was in medbay shortly before the body was reported. Diana, can you clarify — you said Bob was in medbay with the body, but I was in electrical. Did you actually mean Alice? That would line up with what I saw. I'd like to hear from Alice and Eve about their routes.

My route was lower engine, then upper engine, then oxygen — I was working my way up to do my oxygen task when the meeting was called. I didn't go anywhere near medbay this round, so I can't directly speak to what happened to Charlie.

I did see Eve in upper engine at tick 9 as I was passing through. She seemed to be heading somewhere, but I can't confirm exactly where she went after that.

What stands out to me is the direct contradiction between Diana and Bob. Diana says Bob was in medbay with the body; Bob says he was in electrical and that Alice came from medbay. One of them is lying. I'd really like to hear from Alice next — if she was in medbay right before the body was found, that's critical. And Eve, please share your route too, since I can only vouch for her being in upper engine at tick 9.

I'm not ready to vote yet. Let's get Alice and Eve's accounts before deciding.

My route was upper engine, then oxygen, then back to upper engine. I was working on tasks in that area the whole round, so I was nowhere near medbay.

I can confirm Frank's account partially — I was in upper engine and Frank passed through. He says he saw me at tick 9, but actually I saw HIM leave upper engine heading to oxygen at tick 9, so his route checks out with mine. We were in the same area.

I also saw Charlie in upper engine at ticks 2, 3, and 4 — he came in from oxygen at tick 1. So Charlie was alive in upper engine early on, then must have moved toward medbay later where he was killed.

Now, about the Diana vs Bob contradiction — this is the key issue. Diana clearly said Bob was in medbay with the body. Bob claims he was in electrical and is trying to redirect to Alice. One of them is lying about being at the crime scene, and Bob's deflection to Alice feels like a classic duck move — accusing someone who hasn't spoken yet.

That said, I haven't heard Alice's account. If Alice confirms she was in medbay, Bob's story gets stronger. If Alice has a clean alibi elsewhere, then Bob is almost certainly our duck since Diana caught him at the body.

I'm leaning toward Bob right now, but let's hear Alice before locking in.

This is a tough spot for me, so I'll be straight with everyone about my route and let you judge.

My route was electrical, then medbay, then back to electrical. I was in medbay around tick 7 — I saw Charlie come in from upper engine while I was there. I didn't kill him. I left medbay to go back to electrical to finish wiring, and that's where I ran into Bob at tick 9, which matches what Bob said about seeing me come from medbay.

So here's what I can confirm: Bob WAS in electrical at tick 9. That part of his story is true. Which means Diana's claim that Bob was in medbay with the body when she arrived doesn't fit — unless Bob killed Charlie after I left and somehow got back, but the timing is tight.

Now, I won't lie — me being in medbay around the time Charlie was killed looks bad. I get it. But think about it: if I killed Charlie, why would I voluntarily admit I was in medbay right now? I could have lied. I'm telling you because it's the truth and Bob already half-confirmed it.

The real question is Diana. She named Bob specifically as being at the body. Bob has a partial alibi through me. Eve and Frank vouch for each other in the engine area. That leaves Diana's story as the one that doesn't add up. Why would she misidentify Bob if he was actually somewhere else?

I'm leaning Diana. She's the reporter, she named someone we can partially clear, and that's a classic duck play — report the body and frame someone.

Okay, I need to clarify something important since Alice and Bob are spinning this against me.

My route was security → weapons → cafeteria → medbay. I saw Bob in security at ticks 3 and 4 — that matches what Bob said about being in security with me early on. Then I went weapons, cafeteria, and entered medbay where I found Charlie's body AND Bob standing right there with it. That's a fact — Bob was in medbay when I arrived and reported.

Now, Alice is claiming Bob was in electrical at tick 9. That's possible — electrical connects to medbay directly. Bob could have been in electrical at tick 9 and moved to medbay by tick 10-11 to kill Charlie, then I walked in on him. The timing actually works AGAINST Bob, not for him.

Also notice: Alice admits she was in medbay around tick 7 and saw Charlie come in. So Alice and Bob are vouching for each other's electrical alibi at tick 9 — but that doesn't clear either of them from medbay. One of them could have come back.

I stand by what I saw: Bob was in medbay with Charlie's body when I walked in from cafeteria. I have no reason to lie — I'm the one who called the meeting. If I were the duck, why would I report and name a specific player who could counter-accuse me?

I'm voting Bob. Alice's pivot to me feels like she's protecting her electrical buddy.

Alright, let me be very clear because Diana is trying to pin this on me with a story that doesn't hold up.

My route was weapons → security → electrical. I was NEVER in medbay this entire round. When the meeting was called, I was in electrical, not medbay. Diana's claim that I was "standing with the body" is flatly false.

Here's what I actually observed:
- Diana in security at ticks 2-3, then she left toward weapons at tick 4 — that matches her stated route start.
- Alice entered electrical FROM medbay at tick 8, and was with me in electrical at ticks 8-9.

So Alice's account lines up with mine — she came from medbay, joined me in electrical. We were together when the meeting was called. I did not have time to go to medbay, kill Charlie, and be "found with the body" by Diana. The geometry doesn't work.

Diana, you're the one who walked into medbay and "found" the body. You named me specifically — but I wasn't there. That's not a misidentification, that's a fabrication. A duck who kills in medbay and then reports would absolutely try to name someone with a weak alibi to deflect.

Alice came from medbay, yes — but at tick 8, and Charlie was apparently still alive then (Alice said she saw him come in). After Alice left, who else could have entered medbay? Diana, coming from cafeteria. The timing fits Diana as the killer perfectly.

I'm voting Diana. Her story about me is provably wrong, and that's enough for me.

I already shared my route earlier, but now that everyone's spoken, let me work through what we have.

The core conflict is Diana vs Bob. Alice confirms Bob was in electrical at tick 9 — she came from medbay and joined him there. If that's true, Bob being "with the body" when Diana arrived would require him to leave electrical, go to medbay, kill Charlie, and be standing there when Diana walked in — all in 1-2 ticks. Electrical does connect to medbay, so it's not impossible, but it's tight.

Here's what bothers me about Bob's pivot to Diana, though: Diana is the reporter. Ducks who kill and self-report usually name someone they can frame cleanly — but Bob isn't cleanly framable if Alice vouches for him. So Diana naming Bob is either truthful, or a really bad duck play.

On the other hand, Alice openly admitted being in medbay around tick 7 when Charlie arrived. That's the last confirmed sighting of Charlie alive. Alice and Bob are now vouching for each other's electrical alibi — which means if one of them is the duck, the other might be unknowingly providing cover, OR they're both lying.

Eve confirmed my engine route, and I can confirm hers. So Eve and I are essentially cleared of the medbay kill.

I'm torn between Bob and Alice. Diana's account is specific and she has no reason to falsely name Bob if he can counter. I'm leaning Bob, but I want to note: if I'm wrong and it's Alice, she played this very well by admitting medbay proactively.

My vote is Bob, but I could be swayed.

Alright, I've heard everyone now, and I want to refine my read.

First, let me reconfirm: I never went near medbay, electrical, or cafeteria. I was upper engine → oxygen → upper engine the whole round. Frank and I cross-confirm each other in the engine area, so I think we can both be reasonably cleared of the medbay kill.

Now the medbay situation. We have:
- Alice admits being in medbay around tick 7, saw Charlie arrive.
- Alice and Bob vouch for each other in electrical at ticks 8-9.
- Diana says she walked into medbay from cafeteria and found Bob with the body.

Here's what I keep coming back to: Diana named Bob specifically and immediately. If Diana is the duck and killed Charlie in medbay, naming Bob is a terrible play because Bob could easily have an alibi — and in fact, Alice partially provides one. A duck-reporter would name someone harder to clear, or stay vague.

Bob's counter is that Diana fabricated it. But why would Diana fabricate naming Bob when Alice was the one who was actually in medbay with Charlie? If Diana wanted to frame someone, framing Alice would be way cleaner — Alice openly admits being there with Charlie alive.

That detail tilts me back toward Diana being honest. And Alice admitting medbay proactively could be either honesty OR a duck getting ahead of being caught — but combined with her pivot to Diana, it's suspicious.

However, the electrical-to-medbay path IS only 2 ticks. Bob could plausibly have moved from electrical to medbay between tick 9 and tick 11 when Diana arrived. That's actually consistent with Diana's account.

I'm voting Bob. Diana's story is specific, she has no good reason to lie about Bob if he can counter, and the timing works for Bob to have moved from electrical to medbay to kill Charlie right before Diana walked in.

I've already laid out my route and what I saw, but since I'm closing this out, let me make my final case clearly.

Frank and Eve are both leaning Bob. I want to push back gently on one thing Eve said: "Diana has no good reason to lie about Bob if he can counter." That's actually backwards in duck logic — a duck who kills and reports WANTS the accused to scramble. Naming Bob splits the table because Bob has to defend himself, and now we're spending the entire meeting on a Diana-vs-Bob standoff while she sits comfortably as the "honest reporter."

That said — I hear the timing argument. Electrical to medbay IS only 2 ticks, and Bob being in electrical at tick 9 doesn't fully clear him for a tick 11 kill. I can't rule that out.

Here's where I land: I was in medbay at tick 7 with Charlie alive. I left for electrical. Bob was in electrical when I got there at tick 9. For Bob to be the killer, he'd have to leave electrical right after I joined him, sprint to medbay, kill Charlie, and be caught standing there by Diana — all in the last 2 ticks. Possible, but he'd have to be very fast and very stupid to stay with the body.

For Diana to be the killer, she just walks from cafeteria into medbay, kills Charlie, and reports. Much cleaner.

I'm sticking with Diana. But if the table is locked on Bob, I understand — I just want it on record that Diana's the cleaner duck play here.

data.message: hey Eve

Okay, I called this because I found Eve dead in electrical. My route was medbay → upper engine → lower engine → storage → medbay → cafeteria. I saw Frank in medbay from ticks 13-15 doing something, then I headed up to cafeteria.

We ejected Bob last meeting and Charlie was already dead then, so if Bob was innocent, the Duck is either Frank or Alice. I was with Frank in medbay for a few ticks but I can't account for where he went after. Alice — I haven't seen at all this entire round, which is suspicious to me.

Frank, Alice — where were you both, and who can vouch for anyone? I'm leaning Alice right now since she's been a ghost, but I want to hear you both out.

So Diana, I hear you, but calling me a ghost is unfair — I've been working tasks the whole time. My route was navigation → security → weapons → security → electrical → medbay → cafeteria, then back toward electrical. I was doing task work at each stop.

Here's what's interesting though: I was in electrical earlier and it was empty. I passed through medbay heading to cafeteria — Frank, were you still in medbay then? Because Diana, you said you saw Frank in medbay ticks 13-15, and I came through after that.

The thing that bothers me: Diana, you say you went medbay → upper engine → lower engine → storage → medbay → cafeteria, and then somehow ended up finding Eve in electrical? That's a long loop, and electrical isn't on your stated path at the end. How did you end up there to find the body?

I'm not ready to throw Frank under the bus, but I want to hear his route before I vote. Diana, your story has a gap at the end — explain how you got to electrical.

Alright, let me lay it out. My route was cafeteria → medbay → cafeteria → oxygen → cafeteria → weapons → security. I was in medbay around ticks 13-15, which matches what Diana said — she was there with me. I actually saw her leave medbay heading to upper engine at tick 15, so that part of her story checks out.

After that I went back to cafeteria, up to oxygen, back through cafeteria, over to weapons, and ended in security. I was nowhere near electrical this entire round.

Now here's the thing — Alice, your route has you going electrical → medbay → cafeteria, then "back toward electrical." That puts you AT or NEAR electrical right around when Eve would have died. And I never saw you in cafeteria when I was passing through it multiple times. That's a problem for me.

Diana — Alice raises a fair point about how you ended up at electrical, but the simplest answer is you looped back through cafeteria and went down. Her timeline at least intersects with mine in medbay, so I have partial confirmation on her.

Alice, you have no one vouching for you and your path puts you at the crime scene. I'm voting Alice.

To clarify Alice's question — after I left storage I went back up through medbay and then to cafeteria. I actually found Eve's body when I was coming back through that area; I called the meeting from cafeteria after spotting it. So yes, I looped back, that's accurate.

Frank's account matches mine for medbay — he was there ticks 13-15 and saw me leave for upper engine. That's mutual confirmation between us.

Alice, your route concerns me too. You said "electrical → medbay → cafeteria, then back toward electrical." That puts you at the crime scene window twice, and Frank says he never saw you in cafeteria despite passing through it multiple times. I was in cafeteria at the end and didn't see you either.

I'm leaning Alice. Voting her unless something major changes in the next speech.

Look, I need to push back here because you're both building a narrative that conveniently aligns. Frank, you said you went cafeteria → medbay → cafeteria → oxygen → cafeteria → weapons → security. That's THREE trips through cafeteria. Diana, you ended in cafeteria. But neither of you saw each other in cafeteria at the end? That's a hole.

Also — Diana, you "looped back through medbay and then to cafeteria" and found Eve in electrical from cafeteria? Electrical isn't visible from cafeteria. You'd have to actually GO to electrical to see the body. So either you went into electrical (which you omitted from your route) or you're not telling us the full story about how you found Eve.

Frank, you're vouching for Diana hard. She's vouching for you hard. That's a two-person alibi pact, and one of you is using the other as cover. I walked through electrical and medbay — yes — but I didn't see Eve dead when I passed through electrical earlier, which means she died AFTER I left. And after I left, who was heading that direction? Diana, by her own admission, looped back through that area.

I'm not the Duck. Diana's route is the one with the unexplained detour into electrical. I'm voting Diana.

Alice is trying to flip this on Diana, but let me address her points directly.

First, Alice — Diana said she found Eve and called the meeting "from cafeteria after spotting it." That's loose phrasing, but she could've glanced into electrical from the corridor or stepped in briefly. Not a smoking gun. Meanwhile, YOUR route literally has you in electrical TWICE during the kill window.

Second, the "alibi pact" accusation — Diana and I only confirm each other for ticks 13-15 in medbay. After that, I went cafeteria → oxygen → cafeteria → weapons → security. Diana went upper engine → lower engine → storage. We were nowhere near each other for most of the round. That's not a pact, that's one overlapping window.

Third, on cafeteria — I passed through it quickly between tasks. Diana said she ended there. It's entirely possible we just missed each other by a tick or two. But Alice, you claim you went electrical → medbay → cafeteria. I was in cafeteria three times and never saw you. Diana ended in cafeteria and never saw you. That's two witnesses who should have crossed paths with you and didn't.

Your route puts you at the crime scene in the kill window. Diana's route at least has corroboration from me for part of it. Yours has zero corroboration from anyone.

I'm voting Alice.
